meta.privacy_classification: INTERNAL ONLY - contains no personal identifiers by design
meta.rule: No owner name, entity name, street address, parcel number (APN), loan number, tenant contact, or financial account appears anywhere in this repository or on the public site. The property is referred to only as 'the Subject Property (Central Los Angeles)'.

identified_property.asset_type: Single-tenant quick-service restaurant with drive-thru, ground/building leased to a Jack in the Box operator

fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.why: Renewal options, option rent mechanism (fixed vs CPI vs fair market value), notice windows, percentage-rent clause, co-tenancy and go-dark provisions

fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.field: Exact expiration date and any partial-termination rights
fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.why: The 2030-2035 window contains both a base term end and possibly one or more 5-year options; the difference in value is material

fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.field: Current rent roll (base rent, reimbursements, percentage rent history)
fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.why: All valuation math keys off actual NOI, not the benchmark rent used in this model

fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.field: Operating expense history and CAM/tax/insurance reconciliations
fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.why: Confirms the lease is genuinely triple net and quantifies leakage

fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.field: Original purchase price, adjusted basis, and depreciation taken
fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.why: Required to size the capital-gains, depreciation-recapture, and 1031 analysis

fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.field: Existing debt: balance, rate, prepayment penalty, maturity, DSCR covenants
fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.why: A sale may trigger defeasance; a renewal may require refinancing at today's 4.84% 10-year Treasury
Needed for parcel-level FEMA, CAL FIRE FHSZ, CGS seismic, zoning, and Assessor lookups that are currently flagged unverified

fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.field: Building and site condition report / property condition assessment
Insurance declarations page (property, liability, rent loss)
fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.why: Verifies NNN recovery, wildfire/quake deductibles, and whether coverage is adequate given the 2025 fire losses

fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.field: Franchisee entity information and financial statements
fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.why: Tenant credit is the single largest driver of cap-rate spread on a single-tenant asset

fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.field: Seller-side broker opinion of value or appraisal within 12 months
fields_required_before_a_binding_decisio.why: No official source publishes asset-level cap rates; M56 is unverified without this
Determines whether the site can be re-tenanted or redeveloped if the tenant does not renew
Most recent tenant filing (filed 2026-08-12, accession 0000807882-26-000091); net income, sales trends, and closure guidance update the FY2025 10-K picture

tenant_brand_facts_verified.fact: Jack in the Box system size at FY2025 year-end

~70% of restaurants in California and Texas; the company names severe weather and natural disasters as a risk factor

tenant_brand_facts_verified.fact: Lease structure in the brand's own portfolio

'We have generally been able to renew our restaurant leases as they expire at then-current market rates.'

Q3 FY2026 Form 10-Q, period ended 2026-07-05, filed 2026-08-12 (accession 0000807882-26-000091); figures not quoted in this workbook - pull at decision time

lease_clauses_to_audit: Option rent: fixed step-up vs CPI vs fair market value with arbitration - determines who captures the 2030-2035 re-pricing
Option notice deadline and consequence of missing it (a missed window can forfeit renewal)
Percentage rent breakpoint and reporting obligations
Assignment/sublease consent standard and recapture rights
Tenant termination or go-dark rights, and any co-tenancy condition
Landlord obligations that could erode NNN purity (roof, structure, parking lot, HVAC)
Environmental indemnity and existing-recognition of any dry-cleaner/fuel contamination nearby
Condemnation and casualty provisions - critical after the 2025 fire losses and for seismic events
Guaranty by franchisee parent and any personal guaranty (personally identifying details must never be published)
